why.visual_craft: Layout, type scale, colors, icons and button styling are pixel-for-pixel identical except for the body-text color; craft level is the same in both.
why.spacing_rhythm: All block gaps (title→link→fields→body→provenance→buttons) match between the two images; no dead zones appear in either.
why.information_hierarchy: 9C3E dims the quoted message body to a muted gray-lavender, which pushes more visual weight onto the bold title and #sales/あなた labels, making the primary ask stand out slightly more at a glance.
why.preview_readability: B71F renders the body text in a brighter, higher-contrast tone against the dark background, so the actual message content is easier to read than the dimmer body text in 9C3E.
why.provenance_visibility: The '出所 週次同期・田中・10:42 >' line sits in the same muted gray weight, same position, and same size in both images.
why.control_reachability: Cancel / Edit / 送る sit in an identical row directly under the provenance line in both, same distance from the body content they act on.
why.screen_occupation: Overall card height, padding, and element sizes appear the same in both crops.
why.overall: The two are near-duplicates of the same design; B71F edges ahead because its body text is more legible, which matters more for a confirmation card than the marginal hierarchy gain from dimming it.

differences: Message body text color/contrast: dimmer, lower-contrast gray-lavender in 9C3E vs brighter, higher-contrast gray-white in B71F
